columns.name: air_date
columns.description: The air date of the episode.

columns.name: num_worst_vote
columns.description: The number of votes in star classification of worst the episode got, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_nominations
columns.description: The number of nominations the episode received (including both nominees and winners); replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: star_7_class
columns.description: Set to 3 if the episode's 7-star votes exceed 1.1x the average number of 7-star votes across all episodes. Set to 2 if the episode's 7-star votes exceed the across-episode average but are ≤ 1.1x the average. Set to 1 if the episode's 7-star votes are ≥ 0.9x the across-episode average but do not exceed the average. Otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: ratio_between_uncredited_and_credited_roles
columns.description: The percentage ratio between uncredited and credited roles on the episode

columns.name: average_stars
columns.description: The average star rating of the episode.
